chunks: They said: "We heard a youth talk about them. He is called Abraham."

key_terms.يَذْكُرُهُمْ: He mentions/remembers them (referring to the idols)

ai.seo_question: Who did the people say was speaking about their idols?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Anbiya, the people of Ibrahim (often identified as Ur or Babylon) acknowledge hearing a young man, Ibrahim, who was preaching monotheism and refuting their idols. They identify him by name, highlighting his role as a preacher and his challenge to their idolatry. This moment marks a pivotal point in Ibrahim's narrative, leading to his public debate and eventual trial by fire.
